findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Comma/Over/Basic.lean:72-73 `@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem w : φ.left ≫ g.hom = f.hom`.
findings.fix: Delete both `w` declarations and use `Over.w f.hom` (already `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]`, so `simp` discharges these goals).
findings.issue: `CoveringSpace.w` (and `ConnectedCoveringSpace.w`, line 211) restates `CategoryTheory.Over.w`; `proj` is a reducible abbrev for `.obj.hom`, so the statement is `Over.w f.hom` and the proof is literally `Over.w _`. The `@[reassoc]` copies duplicate `Over.w_assoc`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Comma/Over/Basic.lean:137-140 `@[simps! hom_left inv_left] def isoMk`; Mathlib/CategoryTheory/ObjectProperty/FullSubcategory.lean:99-104 `@[simps] def isoMk`, :83 `def homMk`.
findings.fix: Define `isoMk e w := ObjectProperty.isoMk (Over.isoMk e w)` and use `ObjectProperty.homMk` (TauCeti's prevailing idiom) in `homMk`; the four `isoMk_*_left` simp lemmas then follow from the existing simp set (`ObjectProperty.isoMk_hom`, `ObjectProperty.homMk_hom`, `Over.isoMk_hom_left`/`inv_left`) and can be dropped.
findings.issue: `isoMk` (and lines 228-231) hand-rolls an isomorphism and re-derives the inverse triangle (`by rw [e.inv_comp_eq, w]`), which `Over.isoMk` already provides; wrapping into the full subcategory is `ObjectProperty.isoMk`. Same for `homMk` (lines 109, 216), which is `ObjectProperty.homMk (Over.homMk f w)`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Comma/StructuredArrow/Basic.lean:701-702 `theorem eq_mk (f : CostructuredArrow S T) : f = mk f.hom := rfl`; `Over.mk = CostructuredArrow.mk`.
findings.fix: Delete both `mkProjIso`; `Iso.refl _` (or `rfl` on objects) serves wherever it would be used.
findings.issue: `mkProjIso` (and line 246) is `Iso.refl` up to defeq: `Over.mk f.hom = f` holds by `rfl`, and the `FullSubcategory` wrapper adds only a Prop field, so `mk p.proj p.isCoveringMap_proj` is definitionally `p`.

findings.evidence: Lines 103-148 vs 209-259 are textually identical up to the type ascription `CoveringSpace X` → `ConnectedCoveringSpace X`.
findings.fix: State the property-independent part once in a section over a general `P : ObjectProperty (Over X)` (both categories are instances of it), keeping only `mk`, `mk_coe`, `mk_proj`, `isCoveringMap_proj` and `connectedSpace` per namespace. After findings 1-3 are applied most of the shared part is Mathlib's `Over.w`/`Over.isoMk`/`ObjectProperty.homMk` directly and needs no restatement at all.
findings.issue: The `ConnectedCoveringSpace` namespace is a verbatim clone of `CoveringSpace`: `proj`, the `CoeOut`, `totalSpace_obj`, `w`, `homMk`, `homMk_hom_left`, `isoMk`, `isoMk_hom_hom_left`, `isoMk_inv_hom_left`, `mkProjIso`, the `IsIso` instance and `isIso_iff_isHomeomorph` never mention `IsCoveringMap` or `ConnectedSpace` — they are property-independent, so the file states each of them twice with identical proofs.

summary: The category itself is new (no `CoveringSpace` in Mathlib or TauCeti), but `w`, `isoMk`, `mkProjIso` and the `IsIso f.hom.left` instances restate existing Mathlib declarations, and the whole `ConnectedCoveringSpace` namespace is a property-independent clone of `CoveringSpace`.
